known_limits: Historical upstream Git commit and exact Python/dependency runtime versions absent. Packaging verification versions are not inferred historical versions.
No contemporaneous source h5ad hash found; prepared reference profiles and fixed cell membership are preserved.
The original patch_port.py is archived only: it is a one-time patch generator and must not be re-applied to already-patched vendor.
Archived vendor_original/default seed123 and upstream tutorial modules are historical provenance, not executable current paper entry flows.
Configured chain1000 retains indices500..998 by2 (250); actual loop executes999 updates per phase.
Current8 starts from independent cohort data, but measurements and source feature discovery remain historical/cohort-adaptive and exploratory.
Microarray inverse-transformed intensity is not RNA-seq counts; np.rint integer copy drives both initial and final inference.
Execution validated on Linux/POSIX with original fcntl/fork conventions; Windows/spawn-only execution not verified.
